0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0040", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Quoi, révérende mère ?", "sha256": "2d3a25185515a2fdb67d6e313ca98f9f01f274b4b77c9727d8ad2fbd009beffc", "emphasis_spans": 0, "91c0f73452ad0d6452343690313d0a33a275f27e5530f16c2b115c6190a114da", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0042", "tag": "prose", "text": "fr81-u141-r0045", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Vous savez qu’une mère est morte ce matin.", "sha256": "7602baacb2377a4f39427071c332579c60121db70649b88543ad4fe4a8439e66", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0046", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Non.", "sha256": "ac641d7ffd6b132ddcd7d7944dc3ccc96acf3113cab60712c9516858cbfdaab2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0047", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Vous n’avez donc pas entendu la cloche ?", "sha256": "— On n’entend rien au fond du jardin.", "sha256": "f50bfb9543d9230c5b01ae2da72dce2812b6e849a48ace8d956e7d8e801c10c0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0049", "tag": "prose", "text": "— En vérité ?", "sha256": "2b850e0f76effc841a4f7785ac285ef63c3fa625e89a43968ff352089c8bc3c9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0050", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est à peine si je distingue ma sonnerie.", "sha256": "2e11b1c9df386d00791d3aa8e3c7f2cdec75c8d1529696c28a87eabd6fe7cef7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0051", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Elle est morte à la pointe du jour.", "sha256": "ef2466042ce7905ec876d9a936981ca35eb4ea6ecf246232e60f7dc604dfa968", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0052", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Et puis, ce matin, le vent ne portait pas de mon côté.", "sha256": "a166faf6643ede5c3d8005c95a0673725ea926fc0688a161ed1c60be32e671e1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0053", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est la mère Crucifixion. Une bienheureuse.", "sha256": "02069c5c861e7b2df67e6b1a8a89e6bc68ce9a73daab48f3832c9c0ae3e8d1a9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0054", "tag": "prose", "text": "La prieure se tut, remua un moment les lèvres, comme pour une oraison mentale, et reprit :", "sha256": "4a75732c8d5c4c4a6cf8a5dc3404d8b2225e67f25904d3952e59bad08c3f59fa", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0055", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Il y a trois ans, rien que pour avoir vu prier la mère Crucifixion, une janséniste, madame de Béthune, s’est faite orthodoxe.", "sha256": "9094610d95f8acaec5566732422e000338d26958a0b9f97ad62f2a24f6cfe627", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0056", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ah oui, j’entends le glas maintenant, révérende mère.", "sha256": "7194766c1b70da2a34512b67b128bcb49732bc5da5faedf6364c04658ae26e8a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0057", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Les mères l’ont portée dans la chambre des mortes qui donne dans l’église.", "sha256": "7099a66f53939a7dbb0c7d902636275182fa7f936efd9522115a3b39301f172e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0058", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je sais.", "sha256": "9afd0f5fd145624efbe43171685fddbd08c2829ba35edcea2ab3ff8fd394171b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0059", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Aucun autre homme que vous ne peut et ne doit entrer dans cette chambre-là. Veillez-y bien. Il ferait beau voir qu’un homme entrât dans la chambre des mortes !", "sha256": "c8f944b37b389848091cbd5040de29829b87da8eff50f9f28d9cad9ec45e717e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0060", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Plus souvent !", "sha256": "c27ca058e946d65c1e1c4190d27a9850ae479eb67f326d51044d7e2523528e15", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0061", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Hein ?", "sha256": "6f4905b437b6948a18583e0d14b52d7f2dd428bf5712d1870e5426b63921de17", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0062", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Plus souvent !", "sha256": "c27ca058e946d65c1e1c4190d27a9850ae479eb67f326d51044d7e2523528e15", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0063", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Qu’est-ce que vous dites ?", "sha256": "d2c2f2d794c52e00130081a51a79c13c62fe48a35befffe865662c7522916245", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
